outcomes.text: Every part of the message is answered: each question, ask and verdict.
The meal or slot is the one asked about, not the clock's; a meal already had is history.
The right people: who is speaking, who it is for, guests.
The right place: where they are vs where to look vs a route; landmarks and dictated names resolved; negated places excluded.
The right time: now, later or tomorrow; the arrival time; deadlines at the destination.
Exclusions honored: cuisines, places, dishes, areas, with their scope.
Continuity: a correction or plan edit inherits everything it does not change; rejected picks never return.
Inferences stated in one line; at most one question; a fork answered both ways.
Diet rules per member, with active overrides, pass for every diner's named main.
The primary member's gluten scope: a GF version when the order is a pastry, pizza, bread or pasta; shared kitchens pass; the banned phrases never appear.
Profile cuisine exclusions lift only on an explicit ask, with a line saying so.
No seafood-led room when the spouse is at the table; seafood-led signatures flagged.
A named full main for every diner that passes that diner's rules.
The infant's room: calm, stroller room, early tables, never a bar; no outdoor-only seating in rain or cold.
No bar-led or drinking-led rooms; a bar in a dining room is a flag, a wine bar or pub is a fail.
Price: $ or $$; $$–$$$ only with menu mains checked; $$$ never. Shared plates above the cap flagged.
Chains: single shops first; small groups labeled with their count; a household chain verdict beats the location count.
Rating: the floor, a named source, a minimum review count; no pick without a counted rating; household-reported scores honored.
Coffee ritual: a local roaster's espresso with a GF pastry for the primary member.
The day's rhythm: coffee slots, dessert after lunch, gelato after dinner.
Provenance: every fact in the reply maps to an evidence record with a source URL and a read time; the model supplies none.
Serving at arrival: open that day at the arrival time, last order respected, the dish on that day's menu.
Status current: not closed, moved, coming soon or closed for the season; the newest dated source wins.
Weather: the newest official forecast with its issuance time; hazards applied.
Distance and time from the true origin, computed by a tool or labeled about.
No false none: a none names the area and hour searched and offers the nearest place that qualifies.
Favorites first: each member's favorite cuisines and the household's saves, when the ask allows.
Named acclaim for at least the top pick, dated.
A signature dish for each diner, inside their rules; substitutions named.
The format matches the ask: quick, hole in the wall, sit down nicely, takeout.
Variety: no place or plate repeated across the trip or the recent-meals window unless asked; cuisine families count together.
After boring: lead with the city's signature inside the rules, with a split order if needed; no gate lifted.
A trusted-review link and a map link on every pick.
The next step where it matters: book, call first, cash only, parking, validation.
Exactly one clear recommendation when there are two or more picks; never a pick with an unresolved flag on a must.
Left out, with a short reason each, when a likely candidate was excluded.
One phone screen; sources in one compact line.
A save said in conversation is stored with its date and occasion.
A verdict is stored with its type: chain, reported score, price, room, delight, style, loved, chosen.
An override is stored with who, what and until; partial withdrawals applied; the header names the ones in force.
A plan edit is applied to the day's schedule, keeping the overrides and weather still in force.
A location override is stored with an expiry.
The slots cover what is left of the day, including the rhythm slots.
Each slot's place is open at its slot time.
Travel between slots works: order, minutes, parking.
Weather windows respected: outdoors before the rain, off the waterfront under a flood warning.
Attraction rules respected: strollers, ID, hours.
Coverage behind a negative claim: any none or nothing fits names the list or sweep it rests on.
Novelty against regulars: when an alternative is asked, no regular or its same-name sibling is offered.
Exceptions proven: an exclusion's exception clause is used only with named acclaim and a stated reason.
Reaction captured: the owner's next message is classified and linked to the trace.
